player_prompt.intro:
Nge o Player {player_id}. Nge o kubaka Jogo ya Memória.
Kulungu nge i kuunganisha mingi ya mipira ya kadi ku matabua, kulungu ya mbuta nge.
Kuna wakati nge, tonda mbili ya kadi ya kupindukila kwa kutunga nambari ya safu na safu wima ya kadi ya kwanza na ya pili, kama '[0 1 1 0]', wapi kadi ya kwanza i ku safu 0 na safu wima 1, na kadi ya pili i ku safu 1 na safu wima 0.
Kama kadi zote mbili zilingana, nge u pata ponto na kadi zikala zimesimama. Kama hazilingani, kadi zikala zimepinduliwa chini, kwa mfano '.'.
Jogo ikoma wakati mipira yote imeunganishwa.

board.current_board: Kisalu ya bo ke salaka ntangu yai: {board}

invalid_move.wrong_format: Formasio ya kitambi kele mbote ve. Muntu yina ke sala {player_id} me pesa mvutu na mutindu mosi ya mbi, kansi yandi metula yo na kati ya bisono zole-mpamba.
invalid_move.out_of_bounds: Muteyi {player_id} me pona kisika ya kele na nganda.
invalid_move.same_card_twice: Muntu yina ke bulaka {player_id} ponaka karte ya mutindu mosi mbala zole.
invalid_move.already_matched: Muntu yina kebula {player_id} mepona mosi to bakarti yonso zole ya bo mefwanisaka dezia.

game_message.cards_match: Kadi zilizochaguliwa na Player {player_id} kwenye nafasi [{r1} {c1}] na [{r2} {c2}] zinalingana!
game_message.cards_no_match: Kadi zilizochaguliwa na Player {player_id} hazilingani. Kadi kwenye nafasi [{r1} {c1}] na [{r2} {c2}] ni {pos1} na {pos2} mtawalia.

outcome.draw: Bansoni zote zole zafwana na nkama ya kufwana ya makaboni.
outcome.turn_limit: Kipindi cha kusonga kisikwama kikwiza. Kusonga kwakwiza. Muntu 0 wakunyikisa {score_0} makala, Muntu 1 wakunyikisa {score_1} makala.
